video_title: Are The NBA’s New Anti-Tanking Rules Good For The NBA? Addressing BIGGEST Concerns

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: New NBA lottery rules incentivize winning over tanking
quotes.excerpt: What it does more than incentivizing winning is disincentivize losing, which is a very different thing.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: I think what it does more than incentivizing winning is disincentivize losing, which is a very different thing. I think it's a legitimate difference.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Jackson, it does not incentivize winning. What does it do on ties? Does it incentivize ties?

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: There's still going to be a large swath of teams that are not going to be motivated to win games late in the season. However, what you are going to have is the teams at the very bottom, those bottom three teams, are going to be incentivized to win to try to get out of the bottom three.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: New rules discourage teams from intentionally losing games in June
quotes.excerpt: It's going to hopefully get rid of a team in June deciding we're going to try to lose.
quotes.quote: It's going to hopefully get rid of a team in October or in June deciding we ain't trying, we're going to try to lose 65 games.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Washington Wizards' tanking strategy will no longer be viable
quotes.excerpt: The team that got the number one pick in the draft, the Washington Wizards, lost 27 of their final 28 games.
quotes.quote: The team that got the number one pick in the draft, the Washington Wizards, lost 27 of their final 28 games. And they traded for Trae Young and Anthony Davis and they played a combined five games. That will not happen again. Like that formula, that shouldn't happen anymore. That's the point of the system, is to eliminate those situations from happening.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: The NBA will likely move to a live lottery drawing
quotes.excerpt: There is very likely to be a live lottery next year. It is not 100% in stone.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: There is very likely to be a live lottery next year. It is not 100% in stone, but I would say it's very likely. There will no longer be a secret room. So my guy Brian Windhorst will not go to the secret room.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I get a kick out of the secret room. The room is not secret, it's very clearly labeled.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Yes, I know. You love the room. However, the room will not exist anymore and it's going to be out on stage.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Memphis Grizzlies voted against the lottery reform proposal
quotes.excerpt: The Memphis Grizzlies voted against this proposal because they traded for the Utah Jazz's first round pick.
quotes.quote: The Memphis Grizzlies voted against this proposal because they traded for the Utah Jazz's first round pick in 2027 and because the Jazz finished in the top five of the draft each of the last two years, their pick cannot be in the top five of the draft next season. So Memphis thought they got an unprotected 2027 pick, they actually got a top five restricted 2027 pick because it can't land in the top five.
